analysis.cpu_primary: Updates completed in the same30CPU-second budget and paired selected heldout CE/accuracy; show whole-worker costs, including all setup/validation/I/O.
analysis.engineering_speed_gate: All six primary fixed-update pairs pass the registered trajectory tolerances, each training CPU speedup exceeds1, and their geometric mean is at least1.10.
analysis.fixed_primary: Paired initial-state/minibatch equality, every training loss, final parameter tensors, training CPU and whole-worker CPU. Validation-selected quality is separately reported.
analysis.metric: Compute CE once from saved float32 logits cast to float64 using stable log-sum-exp; independently recompute in analyzer with absolute tolerance1e-10. Do not relax any older sealed audit.
analysis.quality_conditioned_comparison: An external-control timing comparison qualifies at a target only when both selected test accuracies reach that target and are within2percentage points for every one of the three paired seeds; otherwise mark unavailable.
analysis.statistics: Primary task means and sample SD; paired differences with descriptive Student-t95% interval for3seeds. No confirmatory significance or equivalence claim. Single-seed supplementary panels are descriptive.

data_design.cremad: Reuse all cached train480/validation120/test120 actor-disjoint clips; dt=1; fixed full-clip features; old heldout has already been observed in earlier studies. No download or new split claim.
data_design.split_randomness: Original SeedSequence([seed, split_id, task_id]); each split is a separate NPZ and only requested split arrays are loaded.

execution.stop_policy: Stop new dispatch on worker failure, STOP_REQUESTED, new cgroup OOM event or exceeded worker memory forecast; drain active jobs and preserve every receipt. No replacement seeds or retries.

fidelity.scope: Finite tested float32 output/gradient/Adam trajectories, not bitwise equivalence or a theorem for every input. The independent kernel proof must also pass before registration.

interpretation: Recovered-source train-only unit fixture. All train/val/test roles use the first8 source training examples. Not a registered cohort, heldout quality estimate, or throughput benchmark.

optimization.av_loss: Original fused CE +0.25(audio CE+video CE)+0.5 symmetric same-recording InfoNCE, temperature0.1; shared linear head and arithmetic late fusion unchanged.
optimization.heldout: Persist selection.json and selected checkpoint hash before opening the test split; evaluate only the selected checkpoint.
optimization.matching: Reuse v2 matched_configuration with effective parameter counts; no padding. Identical frontend/readout initialization across all models; entire HCSN reference/accelerated state_dict identical.
optimization.minibatches: Torch generator seed=model_seed+200003; synthetic sampling with replacement; CREMA-D shuffled passes without replacement, discarding an incomplete final batch.
optimization.model_profile: Both HCSN backends use distribution_free_dual with profile=stable; only the numerical backend differs. Raw profiles are separate train-only mathematical diagnostics.
optimization.optimizer: Adam with PyTorch defaults, no weight decay
optimization.selection: Minimum float64 validation CE among exactly the registered two milestones; earlier update breaks ties. One common fixed LR, no per-model tuning or extra selection opportunities.
optimization.synthetic_loss: Masked supervised token cross entropy only; modeled activity/cost are diagnostics and do not enter this objective.

timing.inference_scope: Complete selected model from in-memory features, including boundary/value/density computation; no media decoding or accelerator transfer.
timing.training_cpu_scope: Minibatch sampling, forward/backward, finite/probability/gradient audit, clipping and optimizer. Complete final update and its overrun are charged; validation/checkpoint serialization outside this clock are included in whole-worker cost.
timing.whole_worker: Isolated child wait4 user+system CPU and whole-process maximum RSS; failures and unselected validation checkpoints included.
